question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They should have been following the instructions carefully.

options.text: The instructions should be followed carefully.
The instructions should have been being followed carefully.
The instructions should have been followed carefully.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They should have been following the instructions carefully."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the instructions" at the beginning.
